# HTTP routes

<!-- Generated by `npm run route:ghi`. Hand edits are overwritten on the next run. -->

This page is built from the running app: it creates the app with `createApp()` and reads `app.routes`
instead of scanning the source code. If a route is added and the page is not rebuilt (`npm run route:ghi`),
`tests/route_danh_sach.test.ts` fails. An empty status means a client screen calls the route.

**148** routes · **6** middleware layers by path prefix.

## Middleware by path prefix

Runs before every route that matches the prefix, including routes added later.

| prefix | middleware |
|---|---|
| `/*` | _(anonymous)_ |
| `/admin` | `cuaNgoaiAdmin` |
| `/admin/*` | `cuaNgoaiAdmin` |
| `/api/*` | `congProxy` → `tranBody` → `cors` → `chanGhiCheoTrang` |
| `/api/v1/admin/*` | `cuaNgoaiAdmin` |
| `/api/v1/holdem/matches/:id/rounds` | _(anonymous)_ |
